mapper.sql: id, user_id, outfit_record_id, status, image_key, prompt, error_msg, create_time, finish_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outfit_image (user_id, outfit_record_id, status, image_key, prompt, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{outfitRecordId}, #{status}, #{imageKey}, #{prompt}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE outfit_image SET status = #{status}, image_key = #{imageKey}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finish_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outfit_image WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM outfit_image WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
